title: Thương mại điện tử căn bản

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of e-commerce including online business models, legal frameworks, and socio-economic impacts.
Comprehend operational aspects of internet-based businesses including infrastructure requirements and management practices.
Gain knowledge about legal and regulatory frameworks impacting e-commerce activities.
Develop foundational skills in managing e-commerce projects including system development and maintenance.
